sources.title: inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-fp8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Introduction We're introducing Ling-3.0-flash, our next-generation native hybrid reasoning model. Operating with 124B total and 5.1B active parameters (~12.4% and ~8.1% of our previous 1T-class flagship Ring-2.6-1T), Ling-3.0-flash matches or outperforms its predecessor across key benchmarks.

sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-flash MoE model with BF16 and serialized block-FP8 checkpoints, 124B total / 5.5B active parameters, and a 3.1B MTP layer

sources.title: Ling-3.0-flash - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-flash, an inclusionai 124B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, demonstrates strong performance in speed, typically ranking among the fastest models with a 78th percentile across eight benchmarks.

sources.title: Ling
sources.snippet: Ling-3.0-flash Ling-3.0-flash is the latest-generation cost-effective model in the Ling series, with 124B total parameters, 5.1B activated parameters, a native 256K context window extendable up to 1M.
